task.title: Display config.yaml in VSCode plugin panel
task.description: Add a new collapsible "Kanban Config" section to the VSCode Kanban panel that displays config.yaml and allows users to open it with a single click.
task.problem: Users can't easily locate or access the config.yaml file within the Kanban system. They have to navigate the file system manually to find and open the configuration file.
task.value: Provides quick access to config.yaml directly from the VSCode sidebar, eliminating file system navigation and keeping configuration accessible alongside tasks.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a workspace with .kanban/ folder initialized And the Kanban extension is active When the user views the Kanban sidebar panel Then a "Kanban Config" collapsible section is visible below the tasks view
Given the Kanban Config section is visible When the user expands the section Then config.yaml appears as a clickable tree item
Given config.yaml is displayed in the tree When the user clicks on config.yaml Then the file opens in the VSCode editor
Given the section naming convention When the section is displayed Then it uses title case "Kanban Config" (not all-caps "KANBAN CONFIG")
